title: 第5章 白熊

content_zh:
白熊放下手里的枪，狞笑了一声走上来。周围的人迅速散开了，林锐一米七八的个头在这个俄罗斯巨汉面前也只有仰视的份。但是他的眼中没有任何惧色，只是平静地道，“我只是就事论事而已，并没有什么不服气的成分。”
白熊却没有说一句话，这个浑身肌肉充满危险爆发力的大汉已经抬手一拳打向了林锐的胸部。他出拳迅速而且干净利落，击打的位置也非常有讲究。只要这一拳击中，足够冲击林锐的心肺，造成短暂的休克。
林锐的动作也不慢，几乎在白熊的双肩一动的时候，他已经同时移动了脚步后撤。避开这一拳的同时，一个迅疾有力的腿法蹬在了白熊的腰腹部。他受过严格的武术的训练，对于距离的把握和时机非常准确。
只是他这一腿却只是让白熊的身体微微顿了一顿，白熊愣了一下，随即暴怒地转身，反手就是一拳冲向了林锐的面部。林锐知道白熊的力量极大，不敢强行格挡，只得向后闪避。
白熊逼退了林锐之后，低头看了看自己腹部的脚印。“又是******中国功夫！”白熊怒不可遏地脱下了身上的衣服，狠狠地掼在了地上，露出了一身钢铁一般的肌肉和满是体毛的胸膛。“我整不死你这小犊子！”
他这一口东北口音的中文，让林锐都有些愕然，也不知道这俄罗斯巨汉是在哪里学来的中文。不过想想也有些释然，俄罗斯和中国的东北地区接壤，这个大汉估计是在那里学会的中国话，顺带着把东北老乡的口音也给学了个十足。
赵建飞在一旁笑了笑道，“小心点，你把白熊惹怒了。”
白熊确实怒了，也不知道是对林锐踹了他一脚愤怒，还是对中国功夫有怨恨。这铁塔一样的巨汉，咆哮着冲了上来。出手再不留一点余地。他的徒手格斗技术是在前苏联时代的特种部队所里流行的纯军事格斗术，西斯特玛。这种源于俄罗斯民间的格斗术包含着徒手格斗及器械格斗两部分。后来在被苏联特种部队所吸收后，应军事要求在原先的基础上进一步发展出了暗杀和反暗杀技术。
在经过军队实战数据的分析及整理归纳后，这种武术被发展到了一个新的高度，现代科学数据使得这一古老的武术更加符合运动力学及人体生理学，甚至有着专门的呼吸方法来帮助减轻身体被攻击所产生的痛楚感。所以又被称为俄罗斯柔术。
这个白熊似乎深谙其道，他虽然暴怒，却没有再盲目进攻，而是死死盯着林锐的一举一动，一边和林锐保持着距离，一边寻找着机会。他明白自己的体格就算是再挨两下也无所谓，但是林锐只要被自己击中一下，就绝对不会有好日子过。
在缠斗之中，白熊终于等到了一个机会，接近了林锐。他双手扯住了林锐的衣服，狂吼一声，拧腰倒举几乎把林锐整个人抡了起来，向后倒摔。这是摔跤之中的德国式后桥背摔动作，从背后抓住对手的腰部位置，再依靠自身的腰力抱紧对手往后面抛出去。
林锐从被他抱住到过顶后摔，整个过程在电光火石之间。林锐双脚一离开地面，就知道不好。连忙伸展腰腹，双脚尽量向后撑开。在自己摔倒的时候保持双脚先着地，并且死死支撑住自己的上肢，在一瞬间他的身体向后弯成了一个很大的弧度，避免了后背和头部着地带来的冲击。
并且借这个机会屈身而起，根本不带任何停留地一个翻滚到了白熊的侧面。白熊这时也才刚刚起身，瞬间林锐的腿就到了，而且林锐这次攻击的是白熊的膝盖外侧。“啪啪啪”一阵连续的急速踹击。
白熊的膝盖终于支持不住，软向了一边，林锐趁他身体矮下来的时候，提起膝盖撞向他的下颚，这一下终于是把白熊给放倒了。他先是因为膝盖被踹伤，身体处于下沉的姿势，又接上这一个顶膝的冲击，整个人都向后仰倒了。
“漂亮！”围观的学员们一阵欢呼，掌声不绝。
赵建飞也慢条斯理地鼓着掌，淡淡地道，“确实漂亮。不过好看归好看，并不能证明什么。你们知道白熊的真正身份么？”
林锐和众人都看着他，不知道他要说什么。

content_en:
Bai Xiong put down the gun in his hand and walked up with a grin. The people around him quickly dispersed, and Lin Rui, who was only 1.78 meters tall, could only look up in front of this giant Russian man. But there was no fear in his eyes, and he just said calmly, "I'm just discussing the matter, and there is nothing unconvincing about it."
Bai Xiong didn't say a word. This big man, whose muscles were full of dangerous explosive power, had already raised his hand and punched Lin Rui in the chest. He punches quickly and cleanly, and his strikes are well placed. As long as this punch hits, it will impact Lin Rui's heart and lungs enough to cause a brief shock.
Lin Rui's movements were not slow either. Almost as soon as Bai Xiong's shoulders moved, he had already moved back at the same time. While avoiding the punch, a quick and powerful kick kicked the white bear's waist and abdomen. He has received strict martial arts training and is very accurate in grasping distance and timing.
But his kick only made Bai Xiong's body pause for a moment. Bai Xiong was stunned for a moment, then turned around angrily, and punched Lin Rui in the face with his backhand. Lin Rui knew that the white bear was extremely powerful and did not dare to block it, so he had to dodge backwards.
After Bai Xiong forced Lin Rui back, he looked down at the footprints on his abdomen. "It's Chinese Kung Fu again!" Bai Xiong angrily took off his clothes and slapped them on the ground, revealing his steel-like muscles and chest covered with body hair. "I can't kill you little brat!"
Lin Rui was a little stunned by his Northeastern accent in Chinese, and he didn't know where this Russian giant learned Chinese. But I feel a little relieved when I think about it. Russia borders the Northeastern region of China. This big man probably learned Chinese there, and he also picked up the accent of fellow Northeasterners.
Zhao Jianfei smiled and said, "Be careful, you made the white bear angry."
Bai Xiong was indeed angry. He didn't know whether it was because he was angry at Lin Rui for kicking him, or because he was resentful towards Chinese Kung Fu. This giant man like an iron tower roared and rushed forward. Don't leave any room for action. His hand-to-hand combat technique is a pure military fighting technique popular among special forces in the former Soviet era, Systemma. This fighting technique originated from Russian folk includes two parts: unarmed fighting and weapon fighting. Later, after being absorbed by the Soviet special forces, assassination and counter-assassination techniques were further developed on the original basis in response to military requirements.
After analyzing and sorting out actual military combat data, this martial art has been developed to a new level. Modern scientific data has made this ancient martial art more in line with sports mechanics and human physiology. It even has specialized breathing methods to help reduce the pain caused by attacks on the body. That’s why it’s also called Russian Jiu-Jitsu.
This white bear seemed to know what he was doing. Although he was furious, he did not attack blindly. Instead, he stared at Lin Rui's every move, keeping a distance from Lin Rui while looking for opportunities. He understood that it didn't matter if he took two more hits because of his physique, but as long as Lin Rui was hit by him, he would never have a good life.
During the fight, Bai Xiong finally got an opportunity and approached Lin Rui. He grabbed Lin Rui's clothes with both hands, roared wildly, twisted his waist and lifted Lin Rui almost up, causing him to fall backwards. This is a German-style rear axle throw in wrestling. You grab the opponent's waist from behind, then rely on your own waist strength to hold the opponent tightly and throw him behind.
Lin Rui went from being hugged by him to falling over the top, the whole process was lightning-fast. As soon as Lin Rui's feet left the ground, he knew something was wrong. Stretch your waist and abdomen quickly and spread your feet as far back as possible. When he fell, he kept his feet on the ground first and firmly supported his upper limbs. In an instant, his body bent backwards into a large arc, avoiding the impact of his back and head.impact on the ground.
And he took this opportunity to bend down and roll to the side of the white bear without any pause. Bai Xiong had just stood up at this time, and Lin Rui's legs arrived in an instant, and Lin Rui attacked the outside of Bai Xiong's knees this time. "Pa, pa, pa" a series of rapid kicks.
Bai Xiong's knees finally couldn't support him anymore and fell to one side. Lin Rui took advantage of his body to get shorter, raised his knees and hit his chin, finally knocking Bai Xiong down. First he was kicked in the knee and his body was in a sinking position. Then he received the impact of the knee and his whole body fell backward.
"Beautiful!" The onlookers cheered and applauded endlessly.
Zhao Jianfei also clapped his hands slowly and said calmly, "It is indeed beautiful. But good-looking does not prove anything. Do you know the true identity of White Bear?"
Lin Rui and everyone looked at him, wondering what he was going to say.
